CHAPTER ONE: GENERAL PROVISIONS

articles.heading: Icyo aya mabwiriza agamije Aya mabwiriza agena – (a) uburyo ushinzwe gutanga amakuru
articles.text:
yiyandikisha;
(b) ingamba zikoreshwa mu kugira
ubushishozi ku mukiriya;
(c) uburyo bwo kubika inyandiko mu gihe
ushinzwe gutanga amakuru ahagaritse
by’agateganyo cyangwa burundu
ibikorwa;
(d) ikigero n’ibisabwa bijyanye
n’ihererekanya ry’amafaranga
hakoreshejwe ikoranabuhanga,
kwishyura cyangwa
iherehekanyagaciro;
(e) ingamba zikwiye zo gukumira ingorane
zikomoka mu bihugu bigaragaramo
ingorane zikomeye;
(f) uburyo n’igihe ntarengwa cyo gutanga
raporo ku bikorwa by’ubucuruzi
bikemangwa;
(g) n’ikigero, uburyo n’igihe byo
kumenyekanyisha ibikorwa
by’ubucuruzi byishyuwe kashi
cyangwa ihererekanya ry’amafaranga
hakoreshejwe ikoranabuhanga cyangwa
ihererekanyagaciro.

articles.heading: Isobanura Muri aya mabwiriza
articles.text:
(a) « nyiri umutungo nyawe » harimo
umuntu ku giti cye ufite ku buryo
nyakuri cyangwa ugenzura umukiriya
cyangwa undi muntu igikorwa
cy’ubucuruzi cyakorewe. Harimo kandi
umuntu ku giti cye ufite uruhare runini
ku mutungo w’umuryango ufite
ubuzima gatozi cyangwa ubwumvikane
bushingiye ku masezerano;
(b) « uhabwa amafaranga » bivuga
umuntu cyangwa ikigo gifite
ubuzimagatozi, ugenwa n’uwohereza
amafaranga nk’uwagenewe kwakira ayo
mafaranga cyangwa agaciro koherezwa
mu ruhererekane rw’ubwishyu cyangwa
rw’ihererekanyagaciro;
(c) « ikigo cy’imari cyakira » bivuga ikigo
cy’imari gicunga konti y’ugenewe
amafaranga cyangwa gishyikiriza
amafaranga uyagenewe, kiri ku rwego
rwa nyuma mu ihererekanya
ry’amafaranga;
(d) « Urwego » bivuga urwego rw’Igihugu
rufite ubutasi ku mari mu nshingano;
(e) « ihererekanya ry’amafaranga
hakoreshejwe ikoranabuhanga,
kwishyura cyangwa
ihererekanyagaciro ryambukiranya
imipaka » bivuga ihererekanya
ry’amafaranga hifashishijwe
ikoranabuhanga, kwishyura cyangwa
kohererezanya agaciro aho ikigo
cy’imari gisaba n’ikigo cy’imari cyakira
biherereye mu bihugu bitandukanye. Iyi
nyito kandi isobanura uruhererekane
rw’ibikorwa byo guhererekanya
amafaranga hifashishijwe
ikoranabuhanga, kwishyura cyangwa
guhererekanya agaciro, aho nibura
kimwe mu bigo by’imari byabigizemo
uruhare giherereye mu kindi gihugu;
(f) « ihererekanya ry’amafaranga
hakoreshejwe ikoranabuhanga,
kwishyura cyangwa
ihererekanyagaciro imbere mu
gihugu » bivuga ihererekanya
ry’amafaranga hifashishijwe
ikoranabuhanga, kwishyura cyangwa
ihererekanyagaciro aho ikigo cy’imari
gisaba cyangwa cyakira biherereye mu
gihugu kimwe. Iyi nyito isobanura
uruhererekane rw’ibikorwa
by’ihererekanya ry’amafaranga
hifashishijwe ikoranabuhanga,
kwishyura cyangwa kohererezanya
agaciro iyo bikorerwa byose mu gihugu
kimwe n’iyo sisitemu yakoreshejwe mu
kohereza ubutumwa bw’ubwishyu yaba
iherereye mu kindi gihugu;
(g) « ikigo cy’imari gihuza » bivuga ikigo
cy’imari mu ruhererekane rw’ubwishyu
cyakira kikanohereza amafaranga
hifashishijwe ikoranabuhanga,
kikohereza ubwishyu cyangwa
ihererekanyagaciro mu izina ry’ikigo
cy’imari gisaba n’ikigo cy’imari cyakira
cyangwa n’ikindi kigo cy’imari gihuza;
(h) « ubwumvikane bushingiye ku
masezerano » bivuga ubwizerane
bwashyizweho mu buryo bweruye
n’ushyiraho ubwizerane hakoreshejwe
inyandiko cyangwa ubundi
bwumvikane bumeze nk’ubwo
bwizerane;
(i) « umukiriya udahoraho » bivuga
umukiriya uza cyangwa ugaragara mu
buryo budahoraho cyangwa rimwe na
rimwe;
(j) « ikigo cy’imari gisaba » bivuga ikigo
cy’imari cyakira amabwiriza aturutse ku
uwohereje amafaranga yo kohereza ayo
mafaranga ku wo agenewe. Icyo kigo ni
cyo ntangiriro y’uruhererekane
rw’ubwishyu;
(k) « uwohereje amafaranga » bivuga
nyiri konti wasabye ihererenya
ry’amafaranga cyangwa ry’agaciro
rivuye kuri iyo konti, cyangwa iyo
hatari konti, umuntu cyangwa ikigo
gifite ubuzimagatozi bisabye ikigo
cy’imari kohereza amafaranga
hakoreshejwe ikoranabuhanga,
kwishyura cyangwa kohereza agaciro;
(l) « umuntu ugaragara mu rwego rwa
politiki » harimo –
(i) umunyamahanga ugaragara mu
rwego rwa politiki, ushinzwe
cyangwa wigeze gushingwa
imirimo ikomeye n’igihugu
cy’amahanga, nko kuba umukuru
w’igihugu cyangwa wa
Guverinoma, umunyapolitiki
mukuru, umuyobozi mukuru muri
Leta, mu rwego rw’ubucamanza
cyangwa mu rwego rwa gisirikare,
umuyobozi mukuru w’ikigo cya
Leta, cyangwa umuyobozi ukomeye
w’ishyaka rya politiki;
(ii) umuntu ugaragara mu rwego rwa
politiki imbere mu Gihugu,
ushinzwe cyangwa wigeze
gushingwa imirimo ikomeye
n’igihugu, nko kuba Umukuru
w’Igihugu cyangwa wa
Guverinoma, umunyapolitiki
mukuru, umuyobozi mukuru muri
Leta, mu rwego rw’ubucamanza
cyangwa mu rwego rwagisirikare,
umuyobozi mukuru w’ikigo cya
Leta, cyangwa umuyobozi ukomeye
w’ishyaka rya politiki;
(iii)umuntu ushinzwe cyangwa wigeze
gushingwa imirimo ikomeye
n’umuryango mpuzamahanga ugize
ubuyobizi bukuru bw’uwo
muryango nko kuba umuyobozi
mukuru, umuyobozi wungirije,
abagize inama y’ubutegetsi
cyangwa indi mirimo ingana na yo;
(iv)abagize umuryango w’umuntu
ugaragara mu rwego rwa politiki
bateganyijwe mu gaka ka (n)(i), (ii)
na (iii) n’undi muntu bafitanye
umubano wa hafi;
(m)« urwego rugenzura » bivuga urwego
rushyiraho amabwiriza, rugenzura,
rusuzuma kandi rukurikirana imikorere
y’abashinzwe gutanga amakuru;
(n) « igikorwa cy’ubucuruzi
gikemangwa » bivuga igikorwa
cy’ubucuruzi cyangwa igikorwa
cy’ubucuruzi cyageragejwe aho
ushinzwe gutanga amakuru akeka
cyangwa afite impamvu zumvikana zo
gukeka ko gifitanye isano
n’iyezandonke, gutera inkunga
iterabwoba no gutera inkunga
ikwirakwiza ry’intwaro za kirimbuzi;
(o) « kohereza amafaranga
hakoreshejwe ikoranabuhanga,
kwishyura cyangwa
ihererekanyagaciro » bivuga igikorwa
cy’ubucuruzi cyo kohereza amafaranga,
kwishyura cyangwa ihererekanyagaciro
bikozwe mu izina ry’uwohereje
amafaranga binyujijwe mu kigo
cy’imari gisaba hakoreshejwe uburyo
bw’ikoranabuhanga hagamijwe guha
amafaranga uyahabwa hifashishijwe
ikigo cy’imari cyakira, hatitawe ko
uwohereje amafaranga n’uyahabwa ari
bamwe, harimo amafaranga abikujwe
mu ntoki.
UMUTWE WA II: IMICUNGIRE
Y’IBYATEZA INGORANE N’UBURYO
BWO KWIYANDIKISHA

articles.heading: Kwiyandikisha k’ushinzwe gutanga amakuru
Igihe cyo kwiyandikisha k’ushinzwe gutanga amakuru (1) Ushinzwe gutanga amakuru mushya yiyandikisha ku Rwego mu gihe
articles.text:
kitarenze iminsi 30 ibarwa uhereye ku
munsi yaboneho icyemezo cy’ishingwa
ry’isosiyete y’ubucuruzi.
(2) Ushinzwe gutanga amakuru amenyesha
mu nyandiko Urwego, impinduka ku
makuru yatanze yiyandikisha mu gihe
kitarenze iminsi irindwi y’akazi ibarwa
uhereye igihe iyo mpinduka
yabereyeho.

articles.heading: Uburyo bw’imikorere bushingiye ku byateza ingorane n’inshingano z’inzego Ushinzwe gutanga amakuru –
articles.text:
(a) ashyiraho kandi agashyira mu bikorwa
uburyo bw’imikorere bushingiye ku
byateza ingorane zagaragaye mu
gushyira mu bikorwa ingamba zo
kurwanya iyezandonke, gutera inkunga
iterabwoba no gutera inkunga
ikwirakwizwa ry’intwaro za kirimbuzi,
akita ko uburemere bw’ingamba
bujyanye n’ingano z’ingorane
zagaragaye;
(b) akora isesengura, ku rwego rw’ikigo,
ry’ibyateza ingorane z’iyezandonke, izo
gutera inkunga iterabwoba no izo gutera
inkunga ikwirakwiza ry’intwaro za
kirimbuzi no kubikorera inyandiko
nibura rimwe mu mwaka n’igihe cyose
habaye impinduka zigaragara mu
mikorere y’ikigo mu miterere
y’abakiriya bacyo cyangwa muri
serivisi gitanga;
(c) kandi akora ku buryo isesengura
ry’ibyateza ingorane ku rwego rw’ikigo
ndetse n’ingamba zashyizweho byita ku
byagarajwe n’isesengura ry’ingorane ku
rwego rw’Igihugu ndetse n’isesengura
rijyanye ry’ingorane rijyanye na byo
ryakozwe ku rwego ushinzwe gutanga
amakuru akoreramo.

articles.heading: Gushyiraho umukozi ushinzwe iyubahirizwa ry’ibisabwa (1) Ushinzwe gutanga amakuru ashyiraho
articles.text:
umukozi ushinzwe iyubahirizwa
ry’ibisabwa mu gukumira no kurwanya
iyezandonke, gutera inkunga
iterabwoba no gutera inkunga
ikwirakwiza ry’intwaro za kirimbuzi.
(2) Umukozi ushinzwe iyubahirizwa
ry’ibisabwa agomba kuba ari ku rwego
rw’ubuyobozi, afite ububasha,
uburambe n’ubushobozi buhagije
kugira ngo ashobore kuzuza inshingano
mu buryo bunoze kandi yigenga.
A
(3) Umukozi ushinzwe iyubahirizwa
ry’ibisabwa agomba kugira uburyo bwo
kugera ku Nama y’Ubutegetsi cyangwa
ku komite bireba y’Inama y’Ubutegetsi
mu buryo butaziguye kandi butagira
imbogamizi, kandi atanga mu buryo
bwigenga raporo ku iyubahirizwa
ry’ibisabwa mu nama z’Inama
y’Ubutegetsi.
(4) Ushinzwe gutanga amakuru amenyesha
Urwego umukozi ushinzwe
iyubahirizwa ry’ibisabwa washyizweho
mu gihe kitarenze iminsi itatu y’akazi
ikurikira ishyirwaho rye.
(5) Igihe cyose habaye impinduka ku
mukozi ushinzwe iyubahirizwa
ry’ibisabwa, ushinzwe gutanga amakuru
amenyesha Urwego mu gihe kitarenze
amasaha 24 abarwa uhereye igihe iyo
impinduka yabereye.
UMUTWE WA III: INGAMBA
ZIKORESHWA MU KUGIRA
UBUSHISHOZI KU MUKIRIYA

articles.heading: Ubushishozi bw’ibanze ku mukiriya (1) Ushinzwe gutanga amakuru akoresha C
articles.text:
C
A
ingamba z’ubushishozi bw’ibanze ku
mukiriya mbere yo kugirana
imikoranire, mu rwego rwo kurwanya
iyezandonke n’ibyaha bifitanye isano,
kurwanya gutera inkunga iterabwo no
gutera inkunga ikwirakwizwa
ry’intwaro za kirimbuzi.
(2) Ubushishozi bw’ibanze ku mukiriya
bikubiyemo –
(a) kumenya no kugenzura
umwirindoro w’umukiriya n’uwa
nyiri umutungo nyawe;
(b) no gusobanukirwa no kubona mu
buryo bukwiye amakuru ku miterere
y’iyo mikoranire n’icyo igamije.

articles.heading: Ingamba z’ubushishozi ku mukiriya zoroheje (1) Ingamba z’ubushishozi ku mukiriya zoroheje mu kurwanya iyezandonke,
articles.text:
gutera inkunga iterabwoba cyangwa
gutera inkunga ikwirakwiza ry’intwaro
za kirimbuzi harimo–
(a) kugenzura ibiranga umukiriya na
nyiri umutungo nyawe nyuma yo
gushyiraho imikoranire yo mu
rwego rw’ubucuruzi;
(b) kugabanya inshuro zo guhuza
n’igihe umwirondoro w’umukiriya;
(c) kugabanya urwego rwo
gukurikirana no kugenzura bihoraho
ibikorwa by’ubucuruzi hashingiwe
ku kigero cy’amafaranga
cyumvikana kigenwa n’Urwego;
(d) no kudakusanya amakuru yihariye
cyangwa gufata ingamba zihariye
hagamijwe kumva intego
n’imiterere by’imikoranire yo mu
rwego rw’ubucuruzi igamijwe
ahubwo hakamenyekana intego
n’imiterere uhereye ku bwoko
bw’ibikorwa by’ubucuruzi cyangwa
ku mikoranire yo mu rwego
rw’ubucuruzi iriho.
(2) Ingamba z’ubushishozi zoroheje ku
mukiriya ntizemewe igihe cyose hari
ugukeka iyezandonke, gutera inkunga
iterabwoba cyangwa gutera inkunga
ikwirakwiza z’intwaro za kirimbuzi.

articles.heading: Ingamba z’ubushishozi ku mukiriya zikomeye Ingamba z’ubushishozi ku mukiriya zikomeye mu rwego rwo kurwanya iyezandonke, gutera
articles.text:
inkunga iterabwoba cyangwa gutera inkunga
ikwirakwiza ry’intwaro za kirimbuzi zirimo –
(a) gushaka amakuru y’inyongera ku
mukiriya arimo akazi akora, ingano
y’umutungo, amakuru aboneka mu
bubiko rusange bw’amakuru
koranabuhanga na murandasi, no
guhuza n’igihe mu buryo buhoraho
amakuru yerekeye umwirondoro
w’umukiriya na nyiri umutungo nyawe;
(b) gushaka amakuru y’inyongera ku
miterere igamijwe y’imikoranire yo mu
rwego rw’ubucuruzi;
(c) gushaka amakuru ku nkomoko
y’amafaranga cyangwa y’ubutunzi
by’umukiriya;
(d) gushaka amakuru ku mpamvu
z’igikorwa cy’ubucuruzi kigamijwe
cyangwa cyakozwe;
(e) guhabwa uburenganzira n’ubuyobozi
bukuru bwo gutangira cyangwa
gukomeza imikoranire yo mu rwego
rw’ubucuruzi;
(f) gukurikirana mu buryo buhanitse
imikoranire yo mu rwego rw’ubucuruzi,
hongerwa umubare n’igihe byo gukora
igenzura no gutoranya ibikorwa
by’ubucuruzi bikeneye gusuzumwa mu
buryo bwisumbuye;
(g) no gusaba ko ubwishyu bwa mbere
bukorerwa kuri konti iri mu izina
ry’umukiriya muri banki igengwa
n’ibipimo ngenderwaho bimeze kimwe
byo gukoresha ubushishozi ku bakiriya.

articles.heading: Ubushishozi ku mukiriya ku bantu bagaragara mu rwego rwa politiki (1) Ushinzwe gutanga amakuru ashyiraho
articles.text:
kandi agashyira mu bikorwa uburyo
bukwiye bwo gucunga ingamba kugira
ngo hamenyekane niba umukiriya
cyangwa nyiri umutungo nyawe ari
umuntu ugaragara mu rwego rwa
politiki.
(2) Umunyamahanga ugaragara mu rwego
rwa politiki, buri gihe afatwa
nk’umukiriya watera ingorane
zihanitse.
(3) Ku mukiriya cyangwa nyiri umutungo
nyawe ugaragara mu rwego rwa politiki
ku rwego rw’Igihugu cyangwa
rw’umuryango mpuzamahanga,
ushinzwe gutanga amakuru agaragaza
ingorane bijyanye na we.
(4) Iyo umukiriya ugaragara mu rwego rwa
politiki ku rwego rw’Igihugu cyangwa
urw’umuryango mpuzamahanga
agaragara nk’umukiriya watera
ingorane zihanitse, ushinzwe gutanga
amakuru akoresha ingamba
z’ubushishozi ku mukiriya zihanitse.

articles.heading: Ibisabwa by’ibanze mu gufungura konti (1) Ibisabwa by’ibanze mu gufungura konti birimo –
articles.text:
(a) umwirondoro w’umukiriya n’uwa
nyiri umutungo nyawe na nimero
y’icyangombwa kibaranga;
(b) umwirondoro w’abashyiraho
umukono;
(c) aderesi yuzuye y’aho umukiriya
abarizwa n’iy’aho akorera;
(d) imiterere mu rwego rw’amategeko
n’imitunganyirize by’ikigo gifite
ubuzimagatozi cyangwa
by’ubwumvikane bushingiye ku
masezerano;
(e) igihugu ikigo gifite ubuzimagatozi
cyangwa ubwumvikane bushingiye
ku masezerano cyashingiwemo;
(f) gihamya y’ishingwa na aderesi
y’icyicaro cy’igikorwa by’ikigo
gifite ubuzimagatozi cyangwa
by’ubwumvikane bushingiye ku
masezerano;
(g) imiterere n’intego y’igikorwa
cy’umukiriya;
(h) n’icyo konti iteganyirijwe
gukoreshwa.
(2) Haseguriwe ibisabwa biteganywa mu
gika cya (1), ushinzwe gutanga amakuru
ashobora gushyiraho ibindi bisabwa
kugira ngo hafunguzwe konti.

articles.heading: Inshingano z’ushinzwe gutanga amakuru ku muntu ukora mu izina ry’umukiriya Ushinzwe gutanga amakuru agenzura ko
articles.text:
umuntu ukora mu izina ry’umukiriya abifitiye
uburenganzira. Ushinzwe gutanga amakuru
amenya kandi akagenzura umwirondoro
w’umuntu ukora mu izina ry’umukiriya.

articles.heading: Kumenya no kugenzura umukiriya udahari imbonankubone Ushinzwe gutanga amakuru– (a) areba kandi akagenzura umwirondoro
articles.text:
w’umukiriya utakiriwe imbonankubone
mu buryo bumwe bukurikizwa mu
kureba no kugenzura umukiriya
wakiriwe imbonankubone;
(b) kandi ashyiraho ingamba zo kwirinda
uburiganya hakoreshejwe ubusabe
butari bwo bumwe cyangwa bwinshi.

articles.heading: Gukurikirana mu buryo bwihariye imikoranire yo mu rwego rw’ubucuruzi n’ibikorwa bimwe na bimwe
articles.text:
by’ubucuruzi
Ushinzwe gutanga amakuru –
(a) akurikirana mu buryo bwihariye
ubwoko bw’ibikorwa by’ubucuruzi
bikomatanyije n’ibidasanzwe, cyane
cyane ibikorwa by’ubucuruzi
by’amafaranga menshi bidafite intego
y’ubukungu igaragara cyangwa
yemewe n’amategeko, agasuzuma
imiterere, inkomoko n’intego y’ibyo
bikorwa by’ubucuruzi, agakora
inyandiko y’ibyagaragaye akohorereza
raporo Urwego;
(b) kandi akurikirana mu buryo bwihariye
imikoranire mu rwego rw’ubucuruzi
n’igikorwa cy’ubucuruzi hagati
y’umukiriya we n’umuntu uba mu
gihugu kigaragaramo ingorane
zikomeye zijyanye n’iyezandonke,
gutera inkunga iterabwoba no gutera
inkunga ikwirakwiza ry’intwaro za
kirimbuzi.

articles.heading: Ingamba z’ubushishozi ku mukiriya ku bikorwa by’ubucuruzi byihariye Ushinzwe gutanga amakuru akoresha ingamba
articles.text:
z’ubushishozi ku mukiriya ku bikorwa
by’ubucuruzi byihariye, iyo uwo mukiriya –
(a) akora igikorwa cy’ubucuruzi
kidahoraho kingana cyangwa kirenze
FRW 10.000.000 cyangwa angana na yo
mu ifaranga ry’irinyamahanga, icyo
gikorwa cyaba gikozwe nk’igikorwa
kimwe cyangwa gikozwe mu bikorwa
byinshi bigaragara ko bifitanye isano;
(b) akora igikorwa cy’ubucuruzi
kidahoraho cy’ihererekanya
ry’amafaranga hakoreshejwe
ikoranabuhanga cyangwa
ihererekanyagaciro imbere mu gihugu
cyangwa ryambukiranya imipaka,
angana cyangwa arenze FRW 1.000.000
cyangwa ahwanye na yo mu ifaranga
y’irinyamahanga, icyo gikorwa cyaba
gikozwe nk’igikorwa kimwe cyangwa
gikozwe mu bikorwa byinshi bigaragara
ko bifitanye isano;
(c) akoze igikorwa cy’ubucuruzi cya kasino
kingana cyangwa kirenze FRW
3.000.000 cyangwa angana na yo mu
ifaranga ry’irinyamahanga, icyo
gikorwa cyaba gikozwe nk’igikorwa
kimwe cyangwa gikozwe mu bikorwa
byinshi bigaragara ko bifitanye isano;
(d) agize uruhare mu gikorwa cy’ubucuruzi
akorera umukiriya kijyanye no kugura
no kugurisha umutungo utimukanwa.
Ingamba zo kugenzura no kumenya
neza umukiriya, zikurikizwa kuri bombi
ari ugura n’ugurisha umutungo
utimukanwa;
(e) ukora ubucuruzi bw’ibyuma by’agaciro
cyangwa ubw’amabuye y’agaciro,
akoze igokrwa cy’ubucuruzi kingana
cyangwa kirenze FRW 15.000.000
cyangwa angana na yo mu ifaranga
ry’irinyamahanga, icyo gikorwa cyaba
gikozwe nk’igikorwa kimwe cyangwa
gikozwe mu bikorwa byinshi bigaragara
ko bifitanye isano;
(f) cyangwa k’utanga serivisi zijyanye
n’ikigega cy’ubwizerane n’isosiyete
y’ubucuruzi, igihe ategura cyangwa
akora igikorwa by’ubucuruzi kijyanye
n’ibikorwa bikurikira:
(i) gukora nk’ufasha abandi gushinga
ikigo gifite ubuzimagatozi;
(ii) gukora cyangwa gutegurira undi
muntu gukora nk’umuyobozi
cyangwa umunyamabanga
w’isosiyete y’ubucuruzi,
umufatanyabikorwa w’ubufatanye
mu by’ubucuruzi cyangwa
umwanya usa n’uwo mu bijyanye
n’ibigo bifite ubuzimagatozi;
(iii)gutanga icyicaro, aderesi y’akazi
cyangwa iy’icumbi, aderesi
y’itumanaho cyangwa iy’ubuyobozi
kuri sosiyete y’ubucuruzi,
ubufatanye mu by’ubucuruzi
cyangwa ikigo gifite ubuzimagatozi
cyangwa ubwizerane bushingiye ku
masezerano;
(iv)gukora nka cyangwa gutegurira undi
gukora nk’ucunga iby’abandi
w’umwuga w’ubwizerane buzwi
cyangwa gukora indi mirimo isa
n’iyo ku bundi bwoko
bw’ubwizerane bushingiye ku
masezerano;
(v) gukora nka cyangwa gutegurira undi
muntu gukora nk’umunyamigabane
washyizweho kugira ngo akorere
undi muntu.

articles.heading: Ingamba z’ubushishozi ku muntu ushobora kuba umukiriya (1) Ushinzwe gutanga amakuru akoresha
articles.text:
ingamba z’ubushishozi ku muntu
ushobora umukiriya.
(2) Iyo ushinzwe gutanga amakuru abona
ko gukoresha ingamba z’ubushishozi ku
mukiriya bishobora gutuma agira
A
amakenga, biremewe kudakoresha
ingamba z’ubushishozi ku mukiriya
kandi bigatangirwa raporo ku Rwego.

articles.heading: Kugira ubushishozi ku mukiriya usanzwe (1) Ushinzwe gutanga amakuru, ashingiye ku buremere bw’ibyateza ingorane,
articles.text:
akoresha ubushishozi ku mukiriya
usanzwe mu mikoranire yo mu rwego
rw’ubucuruzi isanzwe, mu gihe
gikwiye, hitabwa ku gihe ingamba
z’ubushishozi zafatiwe mbere n’uburyo
amakuru yabonetse yuzuye kandi ari
ukuri.
(2) Ushinzwe gutanga amakuru ahagarika
imikoranire yo mu rwego rw’ubucuruzi
n’umukiriya usanzwe iyo ashidikanya
ku kuri kw’amakuru aheruka kubona ku
mwirondoro w’uwo mukiriya, n’iyo
uwo mukiriya afite konti idafite
amazina ya nyirayo cyangwa iri mu
mazina y’amahimbano, agahita atanga
raporo kuri icyo gikorwa gikemangwa.
A

articles.heading: Kugira ubushishozi ku mukiriya uturuka mu gihugu kigaragaramo ibyateza ingorane zikomeye Ushinzwe gutanga amakuru akoresha
articles.text:
ubushishozi buhanitse ku mukiriya mu
mikoranire mu bucuruzi no mu gikorwa
cy’ubucuruzi n’umuntu uturuka mu gihugu
kigaragaramo ibyateza ingorane zikomeye
kandi kitubahiriza uko bikwiye amahame
mpuzamahanga cyangwa kigaragaza ingorane
zihoraho cyangwa zifatika z’iyezandonke, izo
gutera inkunga iterabwoba cyangwa izo gutera
inkunga ikwirakwiza ry’intwaro za kirimbuzi.

articles.heading: Ingamba zikumira zikoreshwa ku gihugu kigaragaramo ibyateza ingorane zikomeye Ushinzwe gutanga amakuru afata ingamba
articles.text:
zikumira, ku gihugu kigagaramo ibyateza
ingorane zikomeye, zirimo –
(a) gushyiraho ingamba zikomeye zo
gutanga raporo;
(b) kudashinga ikigo cyabyawe n’ikindi,
ishami cyangwa ibiro bimuhagarariye
muri icyo gihugu;
(c) kugabanya imikoranire yo mu rwego
rw’ubucuruzi n’icyo gihugu cyangwa
n’umuntu wo muri icyo gihugu;
(d) kutagendera ku makuru y’undi muntu
uri muri icyo gihugu mu gukora
ubushishozi ku mukiriya;
(e) gusuzuma no kuvugurura, cyangwa mu
gihe bibaye ngombwa, guhagarika
imikoranire yo mu rwego rw’amabanki
n’ikigo cy’imari cyo muri icyo gihugu;
(f) gukora igenzura cyangwa gukora
ubugenzuzi bwigenga ku ishami n’ikigo
cyabyawe n’ikindi by’ushinzwe
gutanga amakuru biri muri icyo gihugu;
(g) gukoresha ibisabwa mu bugenzuzi
bwigenga bw’itsinda ry’ibigo by’imari
no kuri rimwe mu mashami yaryo
cyangwa kimwe mu bigo bibikomokaho
biri muri icyo gihugu;
(h) n’izindi ngamba zishobora kugira
ingaruka zimwe mu kugabanya
ingorane.

articles.heading: Imikoranire mu rwego rw’amabanki Ku bijyanye n’imikoranire mu rwego rw’amabanki yambukiranya imipaka n’indi
articles.text:
mikoranire isa nkayo, ikigo cy’imari gikurikiza
ingamba z’ubushishozi ku mukiriya ziteganywa
n’amategeko. Indi mikoranire isa nka yo irimo
imikoranire yashyizweho hagamijwe gukora
ibikorwa by’ubucuruzi bw’impapuro z’agaciro
cyangwa ihererekanywa ry’amafaranga ku
bw’izina ry’ikigo cy’imari kiri mu mahanga
nk’uhagarariye cyangwa ku bw’abakiriya
bacyo.
UMUTWE WA IV: IBISABWA BIJYANYE
NO KOHEREREZANYA AMAFARANGA
MU BURYO BW’IKORANABUHANGA,
KWISHYURA CYANGWA
IHEREREKANYAGACIRO

articles.heading: Amakuru ku ruhererekane rwo kwishyura (1) Ikigo cy’imari gikusanya amakuru akenewe kandi y’ukuri y’uwohereje
articles.text:
amafaranga kandi gisaba amakuru ku
uhabwa amafaranga mu ihererekanya
ry’amafaranga hakoreshejwe
ikoranabuhanga, mu kwishyura
cyangwa mu ihererekanyagaciro no ku
butumwa bijyanye kandi kigakora
ibishoboka ayo makuru aguma ari
kumwe n’ihererekanya ry’amafaranga
hakoreshejwe ikoranabuhanga,
kwishyura cyangwa ihererekanyagaciro
cyangwa ubutumwa bijyanye mu
rehererekane rw’ubwishyu.
(2) Ikigo cy’imari gisaba n’ikigo cy’imari
gihuza mu ruhererekane rwo kwishyura
bimenya ko amakuru asabwa
y’uwohereje amafaranga n’ay’uhabwa
amafaranga aherekeza ihererekanya
ry’amafaranga hakoreshejwe
ikoranabuhanga, kwishyura cyangwa
ihererekanyagaciro, cyangwa
ubutumwa bijyanye byoherejwe hamwe
n’iryo hererekanya.
(3) Utanga amakuru amenya ikindi kigo
cy’imari gicunga konti y’uwohereje
amafaranga n’iyuhabwa amafaranga
n’ibihugu ibyo bigo by’imari
biherereyemo.

articles.heading: Ikigero fatizo gito Ikigero fatizo gito ku ihererekanya ry’amafaranga hakoreshejwe ikoranabuhanga,
articles.text:
kwishyura cyangwa ihererekanyagaciro
ry’imbere mu Gihugu cyangwa ryambukiranya
imipaka, hatarimo kubikuza kashi, ni FRW
1.000.000 cyangwa angana na yo mu mafaranga
y’ikindi gihugu.

articles.heading: Ihererekanya ry’amafaranga hakoreshejwe ikoranabuhanga, kwishyura cyangwa ihererekanyagaciro
articles.text:
ryambukiranya imipaka riri munsi y’ikigero
fatizo gito
(1) Ku iherekekanya ry’amafaranga
hakoreshejwe ikoranabuhanga,
kwishyura cyangwa
ihererehanyagaciro ryambukiranya
imipaka biri munsi y’ikigero fatizo
gito, ikigo cy’imari kibika amakuru
ajyanye na byo akurikira:
(a) izina ry’uwohereje amafaranga
n’uyahabwa;
(b) nimero ya konti y’uwohereje
amafaranga n’iyuhabwa, mu gihe
iyo konti yakoreshejwe kugira ngo
hakorwe igikorwa cy’ubucuruzi,
iyo nta konti ihari hagaragazwa
nimero yihariye iranga igikorwa
cy’ubucuruzi. Mu gihe amafaranga
yakuwe ku kigo cy’imari kitari
ikigo cy’imari gisaba, nimero ya
konti hamwe n’izina ry’ikigo
cy’imari aho amafaranga yakuwe
biragaaragazwa.
(2) Amakuru asabwa mu gika cya (1)
ntagenzurwa hagamijwe kumenya
ukuri kwayo uretse iyo hari ugukeka
iyezandonke, gutera inkunga
iterabwoba cyangwa gutera inkunga
ikwirakwiza ry’intwaro za kirimbuzi,
icyo gihe ikigo cy’imari kigenzura
amakuru ajyanye n’umukiriya wacyo.

articles.heading: Ihererekanya ry’amafaranga hakoreshejwe ikoranabuhanga, kwishyura cyangwa ihererekanyagaciro
articles.text:
ryambukiranya imipaka riri hejuru
y’ikigero fatizo gito
Ku byerekeye ihererekanya ry’amafaranga
hakoreshejwe ikoranabuhanga, kwishyura
cyangwa ihererekanyagaciro ryambukiriyanya
imipaka riri hejuru y’ikigero fatizo gito, ikigo
cy’imari kibika amakuru ajyanye na byo
akurikira:
(a) izina ry’uwohereje amafaranga
n’iry’uyahabwa;
(b) nimero ya konti y’uwohereje
amafaranga n’iy’uyahabwa, mu gihe iyo
konti yakoreshejwe kugira ngo hakorwe
igikorwa cy’ubucuruzi; iyo nta konti
ihari, nimero yihariye iranga igikorwa
cy’ubucuruzi;
(c) aderesi y’uwohereje amafaranga n’izina
ry’igihugu n’umujyi cyangwa aho hafi,
by’uhabwa amafaranga. Mu gihe nta
aderesi izwi y’uwohereje amafaranga,
hafatwa izina ry’igihugu n’umujyi
cyangwa ahahegereye;
(d) umunsi w’amavuko w’uwohereje
amafaranga iyo ari umuntu ku giti cye.
Iyo amakuru yose ku gihe yavukiye
ataboneka hasabwa umwaka
yavutsemo;
(e) iyo uwohereje amafaranga cyangwa
uyahabwa ari ikigo gifite ubuzima
gatozi, handikwa amakuru akurikira, iyo
ahari:
(i) kode iranga ubucuruzi;
(ii) ikiranga ikigo gifite ubuzimagatozi;
(iii)cyangwa inyandiko yihariye
yemewe n’amategeko iranga
uwohereje amafaranga cyangwa
uhabwa amafaranga.

articles.heading: Ihererekanya ry’amafaranga, kwishyura cyangwa ihererekanyagaciro biri munsi y’ikigero fatizo gito bikorewe imbere
articles.text:
mu gihugu
(1) Ku iherekekanya ry’amafaranga
hakoreshejwe ikoranabuhanga,
kwishyura cyangwa ihererehanya gaciro
bikorewe imbere mu gihugu biri munsi
y’ikigero fatizo gito, ikigo cy’imari
kibika amakuru ajyanye na byo
akurikira:
(a) izina ry’uwohereje amafaranga;
(b) na nimero ya konti y’uwohereje
amafaranga cyangwa nimero
yihariye iranga igikorwa
cy’ubucuruzi ifasha mu guhuza
igikorwa cy’ubucuruzi n’uwohereje
amafaranga cyangwa uyahabwa.
(2) Amakuru asabwa ateganyijwe mu gika
cya (1) ntagenzurwa hagamijwe
kumenya ukuri kwayo uretse iyo hari
ugukeka iyezandonke, gutera inkunga
iterabwoba no gutera inkunga
ikwirakwiza ry’intwaro za kirimbuzi,
icyo gihe ikigo cy’imari kigenzura
amakuru ajyanye n’umukiriya wacyo.

articles.heading: Ihererekanya ry’amafaranga hakoreshejwe ikoranbuhanga, kwishyura cyangwa ihererekanyagaciro bikorewe
articles.text:
imbere mu gihugu biri hejuru y’ikigero
fatizo gito
(1) Ku ihererekanya ry’amafaranga
hakoreshejwe ikoranabuhanga,
kwishyura, cyangwa
ihererekanyagaciro bikorewe imbere
mu gihugu biri hejuru y’ikigero fatizo
gito, ikigo cy’imari kibika amakuru
y’uwohereje amafaranga nk’uko
biteganywa mu ngingo ya 25, uretse iyo
ayo makuru ashobora guhabwa ikigo
cy’imari cyakikira n’inzego zibifitiye
ububasha hakoreshejwe ubundi buryo.
Iyo bimeze bityo, ikigo cy’imari
gishyiramo nimero ya konti cyangwa
nimero yihariye iranga igikorwa
cy’ubucuruzi, iyo nimero cyangwa
ikiranga bifasha guhuza icyo gikorwa
cy’ubucuruzi n’uwohereje amafaranga
cyangwa uyahabwa.
(2) Amakuru ateganyijwe mu gika cya (1)
abikwa kandi agatangwa n’ikigo
cy’imari gisaba mu gihe kitarenze
iminsi itatu y’akazi ibarwa uhereye ku
munsi wo kwakira ubusabe buturetse
haba ku kigo cy’imari cyakira cyangwa
ku kigo cy’imari gihuza cyangwa ku
nzego zibifitiye ububasha.

articles.heading: Ibyihariye n’ibisabwa bitandukanye (1) Nta makuru asabwa ku ihererekanya ry’amafaranga no kwishyurana hagati
articles.text:
y’ibigo by’imari iyo uwohoreza
amafaranga n’uhabwa amafaranga ari
ibigo by’imari byikorera ku giti cyabyo.
(2) Iyo habayeho inyungu yo kwishyurana
ikomotse ku ihererekanya
ry’amafaranga hakoreshejwe
ikoranabuhanga, kwishyura cyangwa
ihererekanyagaciro, mu gihe ibikorwa
by’ubucuruzi byakozwe mu izina
ry’abakiriya si ngombwa ko amakuru
ajyanye n’ibyo bikorwa by’ubucuruzi
aherekeza iyo nyungu yo kwishyurana.
Icyakora, ibisabwa biteganywa mu
ngingo ya 23, iya 24, iya 25 n’iya 26
birakurizwa kuri ibyo bikorwa
by’ubucuruzi ubwabyo.
(3) Iyo ibikorwa byinshi by’ihererekanya
ry’amafaranga hakoreshejwe
ikoranabuhanga, kwishyura cyangwa
ihererekanyagaciro ryambukiranya
imipaka, rikozwe n’uwohereje
amafaranga umwe bibumbiye mu
muzingo umwe kugira ngo
byohererezwe abahabwa amafaranga,
ibyo bikorwa by’ihererekanya
bibumbiye mu muzingo umwe
bisonerwa ibisabwa mu ngingo ya 23
n’iya 24, bijyanye n’amakuru
y’uwohereje amafaranga iyo bigaragaza
konti y’uwohereje amafaranga cyangwa
nimero yihariye y’igikorwa
cy’ubucuruzi nk’uko biteganijwe mu
ngingo ya 23 (b) kandi uwo muzingo
ukaba ukubiyemo amakuru asabwa
kandi y’ukuri y’uwohereje amafaranga
n’amakuru yuzuye y’uhabwa
amafaranga ashobora kumenyekana mu
gihugu cy’uhabwa amafaranga.
(4) Ku byerekeye ihererekanya
ry’amafaranga rikomoka ku gikorwa
cy’ubucuruzi cyakozwe hifashishijwe
ikarita yo kubikuza, yo kwishyura
inguzanyo n’ikarita yo kubikuza no
kwishyura mbere mu kugura ibicuruzwa
cyangwa serivisi, nimero y’iyo karita
igomba kugaragazwa ku ihererekanya
ry’amafaranga ryakomotse ku gikorwa
cy’ubucuruzi. Izina ry’ikigo cy’imari
cyatanze iyo karita n’ikigo cy’imari
cyakiriye ubwo bwishyu, naho
biherereye bigomba kugaragarizwa
ibindi bigo by’imari muri urwo
ruhererekane rwo kwishyurana ndetse
n’inzego zibifitiye ububashya binyuze
muri ibyo bigo mu gihe bisabwe.
(5) Iyo ikarita yo kubikuza, yo kwishyura
inguzanyo n’ikarita yo kubikuza no
kwishyura mbere ikoreshwa ku bundi
bwoko bwo kwishyura cyangwa
bw’ihererekanyagaciro, icyo gikorwa
cy’ubucuruzi gikurikiza ibiteganywa
mu ngingo ya 23, iya 24, iya 25 n’iya
26.
(6) Ikigo cy’imari kibika nimero ya konti
cyangwa nimero y’ikarita yakoreshejwe
mu kubikuza amafaranga kashi imbere
mu gihugu.
(7) Gukoresha ikarita yo kubikuza, yo
kwishyura inguzanyo cyangwa ikarita
yo kubikuza no kwishyura mbere
hifashishijwe ikindi kigo cy’imari, mu
kubikuza amafaranga kashi
yambukiranya imipaka, hasabwa ibi
bikurikira:
(a) nimero y’ikarita iherekeza kubikuza
amafaranga kashi;
(b) izina rya nyiri ikarita rihabwa ikigo
cy’imari kifashishijwe mu kubikuza
iyo kibisabwe, ibi bigakorwa mu
gihe kitarenze iminsi itatu y’akazi
ibarwa uhereye ku munsi ubusabe
bwakiriweho.

articles.heading: Inshingano z’ikigo cy’imari gisaba (1) Ikigo cy’imari gisaba gifite inshingano zikurikira
articles.text:
(a) kumenya ko ihererekanya
ry’amafaranga hakoreshejwe
ikoranabuhanga, kwishyura
cyangwa ihererekanyagaciro riri
hejuru y’ikigero fatizo gito rifite
amakuru asabwa kandi y’ukuri
y’uwohereje amafaranga n’amakuru
asabwa y’uhabwa amafaranga;
(b) kumenya ko ihererekanya
ry’amafaranga hakoreshejwe
ikoranabuhanga, kwishyura
cyangwa ihererekanyagaciro riri
hasi y’ikigero fatizo gito rifite izina
ry’uwohereje amafaranga
n’iry’uhabwa amafaranga na nimero
ya konti ya buri umwe cyangwa
nimero yihariye iranga igikorwa
cy’ubucuruzi;
(c) kubika amakuru yakusanyijwe
y’uwohereje amafaranga
n’ay’uhabwa amafaranga
hakurikijwe ibisabwa mu kubika
inyandiko.
(2) Ikigo cy’imari gisaba ntigikora igikorwa
cy’ihererekanya ry’amafaranga
hakoreshejwe ikoranabuhanga,
kwishyura cyangwa ihererekanyagaciro
iyo kitubahirije ibisabwa biteganyijwe
mu gika cya (1).

articles.heading: Inshingano z’ikigo cy’imari gihuza (1) Mu ihererekanya ry’amafaranga hakoreshejwe ikoranabuhanga,
articles.text:
kwishyura cyangwa ihererekanyagaciro
ryambukiranya imipaka, ikigo cy’imari
gikora nk’igihuza mu gihe gikora iryo
hererekanya kigomba kureba ko
amakuru y’uwohereje amafaranga
n’ay’uyahabwa aherekeje ihererekanya
ry’amafaranga hakoreshejwe
ikoranabuhanga, kwishyura cyangwa
ihererekanyagaciro abitswe hamwe na
ryo.
(2) Iyo hari imbogamizi za tekiniki zibuza
ko amakuru asabwa y’uwohereje
amafaranga cyangwa y’uyahabwa
aherekeje ihererekanya ry’amafaranga
hakoreshejwe ikoranabuhanga,
kwishyura cyangwa ihererekanyagaciro
ryambukiranya imipaka aguma hamwe
n’ihererekanya ry’amafaranga
hakoreshejwe ikoranabuhanga,
kwishyura cyangwa ihererekanyagaciro
imbere mu gihugu bijyanye, ikigo
cy’imari gihuza cyiyakiriye kibika
nibura mu gihe cy’imyaka icumi
amakuru yakiriwe aturutse mu kigo
cy’imari gisaba cyangwa ikindi kigo
cy’imari gihuza.
(3) Ikigo cy’imari gihuza gifata ingamba
zikwiye hagamijwe kugaragaza
ihererekanya ry’amafaranga
hakoreshejwe ikoranabuhanga,
kwishyura cyangwa ihererekanyagaciro
ryambukiranya imipaka bidafite
amakuru asabwa.
(4) Ikigo cy’imari gihuza kigira politiki
n’uburyo bw’imikorere bihamye
bishingiye ku ngorane kugira ngo
hagenwe –
(a) igihe cyo gukora, kwanga cyangwa
guhagarika by’agateganyo
ihererekanya ry’amafaranga
hakoreshejwe ikoranabuhanga,
kwishyura cyangwa
ihererekanyagaciro ridafite amakuru
asabwa y’uwohereje amafaranga
cyangwa y’uhabwa amafaranga;
(b) n’ibikorwa bikwiye by’ikurikirana.

articles.heading: Inshingano z’ikigo cy’imari cyakira Ikigo cy’imari cyakira gifite inshingano zikurikira
articles.text:
(a) gufata ingamba zikwiye zo kugaragaza
ihererekanya ry’amafaranga
hakoreshejwe ikoranabuhanga,
kwishyura cyangwa ihererekanyagaciro
ryambukiranya imipaka ridafite
amakuru asabwa y’uwohereje
amafaranga cyangwa y’uhabwa
amafaranga. Izo ngamba zishobora kuba
zirimo gukurikirana nyuma y’igikorwa
cyangwa gukurikirana bikozwe ako
kanya aho bishoboka;
(b) ku ihererekanya ry’amafaranga
hakoreshejwe ikoranabuhanga,
kwishyura cyangwa ihererekanyagaciro
ryambukirinya imipaka riri hejuru
y’ikigero fatizo gito, kugenzura
umwirindoro w’uhabwa amafaranga iyo
uwo mwirondoro utagenzuwe mbere no
kubika ayo makuru hakurikijwe
ibisabwa mu kubika inyandiko.
Amakuru yakiriwe k’uwagenewe
guhabwa amafaranga agomba kuba
afasha mu gukurikirana ikigo cy’imari
cyakira hagamijwe gutahura ubwishyu
bwayobejwe biturutse ku iyezandonke,
uburiganya cyangwa kwibeshya;
(c) gufata ingamba zo kugabanya ingorane
zatuma ihererekanya ry’amafaranga
rikorwa ku utagenewe guhabwa
amafaranga. Izo gamba harimo nibura
imwe muri izi zikurikira:
(i) ku buri gikorwa cy’ubucuruzi,
kugenzura ikigero izina na nimero
ya konti y’uhabwa amafaranga biri
mu butumwa bw’ubwishyu bihura
n’amakuru abitswe n’ikigo cy’imari
cyakira;
(ii) gukurikirana mu buryo buhoraho
hagamijwe kumenya konti,
ibikorwa by’ubucuruzi n’imikorere
bidasanzwe, harimo n’amakuru
y’uhabwa amafaranga adahuye,
hakurikijwe uburyo bushingiye ku
isesengura ry’ingorane;
(iii)iyo ikigo cy’imari cyakira n’ikigo
cy’imari gisaba byombi bigira
uruhare mu buryo bwo kwemeza
mbere, nko kwemeza no gusuzuma
uwishyurwa hagamijwe kugenzura
kuri buri gikorwa cy’ubucuruzi ko
izina na nimero ya konti by’uhabwa
amafaranga biri mu butumwa
bw’ubwishyu bihuye n’amakuru
afitwe n’ikigo cy’imari cyakira, uko
kwemeza mbere bishobora
gukoreshwa mu mwanya
w’ibiteganijwe mu gaka ka (i)
cyangwa aka (ii);
(d) kugira politiki n’uburyo bw’imikorere
buhamye bishingiye ku ngorane mu
kugena–
(i) igihe cyo gukora, kwanga cyangwa
guhagarika by’agateganyo
ihererekanya ry’amafaranga
hakoreshejwe ikoranabuhanga,
kwishyura cyangwa
ihererekanyagaciro idafite amakuru
asabwa y’uwohereje amafaranga
cyangwa ay’uhabwa amafaranga
cyangwa mu gihe hatahuwe ko
ubwishyu bwayobejwe mu gihe cyo
gushyira mu bikorwa ibisabwa mu
duka twa (b) na (c);
(ii) n’ibikorwa bikwiye by’ikurikirana;
(e) gufata nk’igikorwa gikemangwa
ihererekanya ry’amafaranga
hakoreshejwe ikorabuhanga, kwishyura
cyangwa ihererekanyagaciro cyangwa
igikorwa cy’ubucuruzi kijyanye na ryo
kidafite amakuru asabwa y’uwohereje
amafaranga cyangwa ayuhabwa
amafaranga, kikakimenyesha Urwego.

articles.heading: Utanga serivisi y’ihererekanya ry’amafaranga cyangwa iy’ihererekanyagaciro (1) Utanga serivisi y’ihererekanya
articles.text:
ry’amafaranga cyangwa
y’ihererekanyagaciro yubahiriza
ibiteganijwe n’aya mabwiriza, mu
bihugu akoreramo, mu buryo
butaziguye cyangwa binyuze mu
ntumwa.
(2) Utanga serivisi cyangwa uri mu
ruhererekane rw’abatanga serivisi
z’ihererekanya ry’amafaranga cyangwa
ihererekanyagaciro agenzura uruhande
rusaba n’urwakira ubwishyu cyangwa
ihererekanyagaciro –
(a) yita ku makuru y’impande zombi,
urwohereje n’uruhabwa amafaranga
hagamijwe kureba ko raporo
y’igikorwa gikemangwa yatangwa;
(b) kandi atanga raporo ku gikorwa
gikemangwa mu gihugu
cyagizweho ingaruka n’igikorwa
cy’ihererekanya ry’amafaranga
hakoreshejwe ikoranabuhanga,
kwishyura cyangwa
ihererekanyagaciro rikemangwa no
guha Urwego amakuru ya ngombwa
kuri icyo gikorwa cy’ubucuruzi.
UMUTWE WA V: INGAMBA ZIKUMIRA

articles.heading: Ingamba n’uburyo bw’imikorere by’imbere mu kigo Ushinzwe gutanga amakuru ashyiraho ingamba n’uburyo bw’imikorere by’imbere mu kigo byo
articles.text:
kumenyesha abakozi be politiki n’uburyo
bw’imikorere biriho byo kurwanya
iyezandonke, gutera inkunga iterabwoba no
gutera inkunga ikwirakwiza ry’intwaro za
kirimbuzi. Agomba kandi gushyiraho uburyo
bwo gukurikirana mu rwego rwo gutuma izo
politiki zishyirwa mu bikorwa uko bikwiye.

articles.heading: Ubugenzuzi bwigenga (1) Ushinzwe gutanga amakuru agira ubugenzuzi bwigenga bwo gusuzuma ibi bikurikira
articles.text:
(a) iyubahirizwa rya politiki, uburyo
bw’imikorere n’ubugenzuzi byo
kurwanya iyezandonke, gutera
inkunga iterabwoba no gutera
inkunga ikwirakwiza ry’intwaro za
kirimbuzi no kugenzura niba
ingamba ziriho zijyanye
n’iterambere n’impinduka bya
vuba;
(b) imiterere n’imikorere myiza ya
gahunda y’iyubahirizwa;
(c) uburyo bwizewe, butabogamye
kandi bukozwe ku gihe bwo
gutanga raporo z’imbere
n’izitegetswe n’uburyo bwo
gucunga sisitemu y’amakuru.
(2) Ushinzwe gutanga amakuru yita ku
ikorwa ry’ubugenzuzi bwigenga
bukorwa ku rwego rw’ikigo nibura
rimwe mu mwaka n’igihe cyose bibaye
ngombwa.

articles.heading: Gahunda zo kubaka ubushobozi n’iz’ubukangurambaga (1) Ushinzwe gutanga amakuru ategura gahunda zihoraho z’amahugurwa
articles.text:
n’iz’ubukangurambaga ku bakozi ku
byerekeye imikorere n’ingamba byo
kurwanya iyezandonke, gutera inkunga
iterabwoba no gutera inkunga
ikwirakwiza ry’intwaro za kirimbuzi.
(2) Ibikorwa byo kongerera ubushobozi
bitegurirwa abakozi bijyana
n’inshingano bafite mu gutahura
ibikorwa by’iyezandonke, gutera
inkunga iterabwoba no gutera inkunga
ikwirakwiza ry’intwaro za kirimbuzi
n’urwego rw’ingorane z’iyezandonke,
gutera inkunga iterabwoba no gutera
inkunga ikwirakwiza ry’intwaro za
kirimbuzi ushinzwe gutanga amakuru
ahura na zo.

articles.heading: Gukurikirana amashami, ibigo byabyawe n’ibindi n’ibiro biri mu mahanga (1) Ushinzwe gutanga amakuru akurikirana
articles.text:
amashami, ibigo byabyawe n’ibindi
cyangwa ibiro biri mu mahanga mu
rwego rwo kumenya niba bikurikiza
ingamba zo kurwanya iyezandonke,
gutera inkunga iterabwoba no gutera
inkunga ikwirakwiza ry’intwaro za
kirimbuzi mu buryo buhuye n’ibisabwa
byo mu gihugu bikomokamo.
(2) Iyo amashami, ibigo byabyawe n’ibindi
cyangwa ibiro byo mu mahanga
bikorera mu gihugu kitemera ko
ingamba ziteganyijwe mu gika cya (1)
zishyirwa mu bikorwa mu buryo
bukwiye, amatsinda y’ibigo by’imari
n’abandi bashinzwe gutanga amakuru
bakoresha ingamba z’inyongera kugira
ngo bacunge ingorane zijyanye
n’iyezandonke, gutera inkunga
iterabwoba no gutera inkunga
ikwirakwiza ry’intwaro za kirimbuzi.
(3) Iyo ingamba z’inyongera ziteganyijwe
mu gika cya (2) zidahagije, urwego
rubifitiye ububasha mu gihugu
bikomokamo rushyiraho ibikorwa
by’ubugenzuzi by’inyongera harimo
ubugenzuzi bw’inyongera ku itsinda
ry’ibigo by’imari, byaba ngombwa
rugasaba itsinda ry’ibigo by’imari
guhagarika ibikorwa byaryo mu gihugu
cyabyakiriye.

articles.heading: Gushyira mu bikorwa ibihano byo mu rwego rw’imari byagenwe Ushinzwe gutanga amakuru yubahiriza
articles.text:
ibikubiye mu mategeko n’amabwiriza
byerekeye ibihano byo mu rwego rw’imari
byagenwe kandi akita ku ishyirwa mu bikorwa
ryabyo mu gihe kidatinze cyagenwe n’Urwego
mu rwego rwo kubahiriza igihe ntarengwa
cy’amasaha 24 gitangira kubarwa uhereye igihe
umuntu yashyiriwe ku rutonde.

articles.heading: Ubuyobozi bugenzura Urwego rugenzura rushyiraho kandi rugashyira mu bikorwa uburyo bwo kugenzura bushingiye
articles.text:
ku ngorane hagamijwe kumenya ko abashinzwe
gutanga amakuru bubahiriza ibisabwa mu
rwego rwo kurwanya iyenzandonke, gutera
inkunga iterabwoba, no gutera inkunga
ikwirakwiza ry’intwaro za kirimbuzi, harimo
igenzura, gahunda z’ubukangurambaga n’ibindi
bikorwa by’ingenzi ku bashinzwe gutanga
amakuru rugenzura.
Ingingo 38: Ihuriro
Urwego rushyiraho ihuriro ry’inzego zibifitiye
ububasha hagamijwe kubahiriza mu buryo
bunoze ibisabwa mu kurwanya iyezandonke,
kurwanya gutera inkunga iterabwoba no gutera
inkunga ikwirakwiza ry’intwaro za kirimbuzi
ndetse no gutanga ibitekerezo nama.
UMUTWE WA VI: UBURYO N’IGIHE
NTARENGWA BYO GUTANDA RAPORO
KU GIKORWA CY’UBUCURUZI
CYANGWA KU GIKORWA
BIKEMANGWA

articles.heading: Uburyo bwo kumenyekanisha igikorwa cy’ubucuruzi cyangwa igikorwa bikemangwa (1) Ushinzwe gutanga amakuru amenyesha
articles.text:
Urwego igihe aketse cyangwa afite
impamvu zituma akeka ko amafaranga
cyangwa undi mutungo ari indonke
ikomoka ku cyaha, bifitanye isano
cyangwa aho bihurira n’iyezandonke,
gutera inkunga iterabwoba cyangwa
gutera inkunga inkwirakwiza ry’intwaro
za kirimbuzi hatitawe ku ngano
y’amafaranga arimo.
(2) Ushinzwe gutanga amakuru amenyesha
Urwego igikorwa cy’ubucuruzi
cyangwa igikorwa bikemangwa
akoresheje inyandiko yabugenewe
ishyirwaho n’Urwego.
(3) Ushinzwe gutanga amakuru ashyikiriza
Urwego raporo y’igikorwa
cy’ubucuruzi cyangwa igikorwa
bikemangwa mu gihe kitarenze amasaha
24 abarwa uhereye igihe byabereye.
Raporo yoherezwa hifashishijwe
ikoranabuhanga cyangwa ubundi buryo
bushobora kugenwa n’Urwego.
(4) Urwego rutanga umurongo
ngenderwaho hagamije gufasha
ushinzwe gutanga amakuru kubahiriza
ibiteganywa n’aya mabwiriza.

articles.heading: Ibipimo n’uburyo bwo kumenya igikorwa cy’ubucuruzi cyangwa igikorwa bikemangwa Urwego rushyiraho ibipimo n’uburyo
articles.text:
byifashishwa mu kumenya igikorwa
cy’ubucuruzi cyangwa igikorwa bikemangwa.
UMUTWE WA VII: IKIGERO, UBURYO
N’IGIHE NTARENGWA BYO GUTANGA
RAPORO KU GIKORWA
CY’UBUCURUZI CYANGWA KU
IHEREREKANYAGACIRO

articles.heading: Ikigero cy’igikorwa cy’ubucuruzi cyangwa cy’ihererekanyagaciro (1) Ushinzwe gutanga amakuru ashyikiriza
articles.text:
Urwego raporo y’igikorwa
cy’ubucuruzi cyishyuwe kashi cyangwa
ihererekanyagaciro ku bigero
bikurikira:
(a) amafaranga angana cyangwa arenze
FRW 10.000.000 cyangwa angana
na yo mu ifaranga ry’irinyamahanga
iyo bikozwe n’umukiriya
udahoraho, uretse iyo uyohereje
n’uyakira ari amabanki cyangwa
ibindi bigo by’imari;
(b) amafaranga angana cyangwa arenze
FRW 3.000.000 cyangwa angana na
yo mu ifaranga ry’irinyamahanga
iyo bikozwe muri kazino;
(c) amafaranga angana cyangwa arenze
FRW 15.000.000 cyangwa angana
na yo mu ifaranga ry’irinyamahanga
iyo bikozwe n’umucuruzi w’ibyuma
n’amabuye by’agaciro.
(2) Amafaranga angana cyangwa arenze
FRW 1.000.000 cyangwa angana na yo
mu ifaranga ry’irinyamahanga, iyo
igikorwa cy’ubucuruzi cyangwa
cy’ihererekanya giteganyijwe mu gika
cya (1) gikozwe hakoreshejwe
ihererekanya hifashishijwe
ikoranabuhanga.
(3) Ibiteganyijwe mu gika cya (1)
bikoreshwa ku gikorwa by’ubucuruzi
cyangwa cy’ihererekanya gikozwe
nk’igikorwa kimwe cyangwa byinshi
bigaragara ko bifitanye isano, igiteranyo
cyabyo kikarenga ikigero.

articles.heading: Uburyo n’igihe byo gutanga raporo ku gikorwa cy’ubucuruzi cyangwa ku ihererekanyagaciro Ushinzwe gutanga amakuru amenyesha
articles.text:
Urwego igikorwa cy’ubucuruzi cyishyuwe
kashi, ihererekanya ry’amafaranga
hakoreshejwe ikoranabuhanga cyangwa
ihererekanyagaciro akoresheje inyandiko
yabugenewe itangwa n’Urwego mu gihe
kitarenze iminsi ibiri y’akazi ibarwa uhereye ku
munsi igikorwa cy’ubucuruzi cyabereyeho.
UMUTWE WA VIII: INGINGO
ZINYURANYE N’IZISOZA

articles.heading: Uburyo bwo kubika inyandiko (1) Ku gikorwa cy’ubucuruzi, ushinzwe gutanga amakuru abika inyandiko za
articles.text:
ngombwa zijyanye n’ibikorwa
by’ubucuruzi byakorewe imbere mu
Gihugu cyangwa mu mahanga mu gihe
cy’imyaka nibura icumi ibarwa uhereye
ku munsi icyo gikorwa cyarangiriyeho.
(2) Ku byerekeye inyandiko zabonetse mu
gihe cy’ingamba z’ubushishozi ku
mukiriya, izijyanye na konti, izijyanye
n’ihanahana ry’ubutumwa mu rwego
rw’ubucuruzi, n’iz’ibyavuye mu
isesengura ryakozwe, ushinzwe gutanga
amakuru abika izo nyandiko mu gihe
cy’imyaka nibura icumi ibarwa uhereye
ku munsi imikoranire y’ubucuruzi
yahagarariye cyangwa nyuma y’umunsi
w’igikorwa cy’ubucuruzi kidahoraho.
(3) Iyo ushinzwe gutanga amakuru
ahagaritse by’agateganyo cyangwa
burundu ibikorwa bye, ashyikiriza
urwego rugenzura, mu gihe kitarenze
iminsi 30 ibarwa uhereye ku munsi
ibikorwa byahagaritswe by’agateganyo
cyangwa burundu, inyandiko zose
abitse hagamijwe kubahiriza ibisabwa
mu gukumira no kurwanya
iyezandonke, gutera inkunga
iterabwoba no gutera inkunga
ikwirakwiza ry’intwaro za kirimbuzi.
(4) Iyo umuryango udaharanira inyungu
uhagaritse by’agateganyo cyangwa
burundu ibikorwa byawo, ushyikiriza
urwego rushinzwe gushyiriraho
amabwiriza, kugenzura cyangwa
gukurikirana imiryango idaharanira
inyungu, mu gihe kitarenze iminsi 30
ibarwa uhereye ku munsi umuryango
udaharanira inyungu uhagaritseho
by’agateganyo cyangwa burundu
ibikorwa byawo, inyandiko zose ubitse
hagamijwe kubahiriza ibisabwa mu
gukumira no kurwanya iyezandonke,
gutera inkunga iterabwoba no gutera
inkunga ikwirakwiza ry’intwaro za
kirimbuzi.
(5) Urwego rugenzura n’urwego rushinzwe
gushyiriraho amabwiriza, kugenzura
cyangwa gukurikirana imiryango
idaharanira inyungu rwashyikirijwe
inyandiko zari zibitswe hagamijwe
kubahiriza ibisabwa mu gukumira no
kurwanya iyezandonke, gutera inkunga
iterabwoba no gutera inkunga
ikwirakwiza ry’intwaro za kirimbuzi
ruzibika mu gihe cy’imyaka nibura
icumi ibarwa uhereye ku munsi
rwazakiriyeho.

articles.heading: Raporo y’umwaka ku ishyirwa mu bikorwa ry’ibisabwa (1) Ushinzwe gutanga amakuru atanga raporo ku iyubahirizwa ry’ibisabwa buri
articles.text:
mwaka igaragaza ibikorwa byakozwe
mu ishyirwa mu bikorwa rya gahunda
yo kurwanya iyezandonke, gutera
inkunga iterabwoba no gutera inkunga
ikwirakwizwa ry’intwaro za kirimbuzi.
(2) Raporo iteganyijwe mu gika cya (2)
ishyikirizwa urwego rugenzura, Urwego
rukagenerwa kopi hifashishijwe
inyandiko yagenwe kandi bigakorwa
mu gihe cyagenwe.

articles.heading: Ingingo ivanaho Amabwiriza n° 002/FIC/2023 yo kuwa 26/06/2023 yerekeye kurwanya iyezandonke,
articles.text:
gutera inkunga iterabwoba no gutera inkunga

avanyweho.
